references.text: Moses anoints Aaron with the holy anointing oil, consecrating him for priestly service to the Lord.
Aaron and his sons are anointed to serve as priests for the Lord.
God commands that Aaron and his sons be anointed for priestly service, a permanent ordinance.
Moses pours the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anoints him to consecrate him for priestly service.
Moses anoints Aaron and his sons along with their garments to consecrate them.
Aaron receives his share of the burnt offerings as an eternal right granted through the anointing.
The priests' portion of the grain offerings is described as a covenant of salt, linked to their consecration.
Every high priest is chosen from among people and appointed to serve God, just as Aaron was consecrated.
The law appoints human beings with weaknesses as high priests, in contrast to Christ's perfect priesthood.
